needDecideCapability: Ask an administrator for application-decision access to accept or reject.
noQuestionsYetDesc: Add fields applicants will answer. Name, email and logistics are collected separately.
fieldReferencesMissingSection: Question "{key}" points to a section that does not exist.
optionWithNoValue: "{key}" has an option with no value.
revokeSpotWarning: The applicant will lose the place and be notified. Their dietary data stays on the account, but is no longer used for confirmed-attendee planning.
sendDecisionsDesc: Emails every unsent decision. Accepted applicants get a spot-confirmation link.
shirtSizeRequiredDesc: Applicants of this type must supply a shirt size.
submissionsAppearHereDesc: Submissions appear here once applicants complete the form.
askShirtSizeDesc: Adds shirt size to the form and requires it at submit.
askFoodIntolerancesDesc: Adds dietary restrictions and notes to the form (optional for the applicant).
grantsRolesDesc: Assigned to the applicant when their response is confirmed.
grantsRolesNotRetroactiveNotice: Won't affect already-confirmed responses — only future confirmations.
generatedAutomatically: Generated from the question. Change it only for technical integrations.
reservedKeysDesc: The identifier (the key) is what tells each question apart. Some identifiers are special: if a question uses exactly one of them, its answer autofills from the data the applicant already has saved on their profile, and whatever they answer is saved back there too.
reservedKeyDni: — syncs with the applicant's national ID (DNI/NIE) on their profile.
missingReservedKeyDesc: This form has no question using the special identifier "{keys}", so it won't autofill or sync with the applicant's profile. You can save anyway or go back and add it.
anonymousAuditRetentionHint: Only explicitly retained answers are copied after identity removal. New fields default to no retention.
anonymousAuditRetentionWarning: Anonymous data can still be sensitive or re-identifying. Enable this only when the field is needed for event or grant auditing.
anonymousAuditDimensionHint: Use a stable slug for reports. This label does not enable retention by itself.
internalDecisionNotice: Internal only — the applicant has not received this decision.
reviewAutosaveHint: Your score and notes save automatically.
judgingRoomsEmptyDesc: Judging rooms will appear here when they are configured.
scheduleEmptyDesc: The schedule will appear here when published.
sponsorsEmptyDesc: Sponsors will appear here when published.
tvReconnecting: The display is reconnecting to the event service.
challengeUnpublishedDesc: It may have been unpublished or the link is incorrect.
publicEventUnavailable: The public event information is temporarily unavailable.
couldNotLoadStatistics: These statistics could not be loaded.
applicationStatsAdditionalAccess: Pre-event statistics also require application read access.
dietaryConfirmedOnlyPolicy: Includes confirmed attendees only. This is not an optional filter.
presentNowEstimatedWarning: Estimated from doors, meals and activities; not a guaranteed count
attendanceHoursEstimated: Hours combine actual signals and estimated windows.
removalEligibilityUnavailable: Delete versus anonymize eligibility cannot be checked safely. No change was made.
couldNotRemoveAccount: The account could not be removed.
accountAccessRevokedConsequence: Access will be revoked and sessions will be closed.
operationalHistoryRetainedConsequence: Personal data will be removed; anonymized operational history will remain.
freshAccountRemovedConsequence: The fresh account will be fully deleted because it has no operational history.
resetJudgingDataDescription: Permanently removes every project and import, project membership, queue movement, review, judging session, winner, judge assignment, and queue routing record for this event. Accounts, applications, event settings, challenge definitions, rooms, and the audit trail stay.
resetJudgingDataWarning: This affects everyone in the event.
resetJudgingDataUseOnlyWhenNeeded: Use only to restart a broken import or judging run. Delivered emails cannot be recalled.
resetJudgingDataFirstConfirmDescription: This is the first confirmation. Nothing has been deleted yet.
resetJudgingDataDeletesProjects: Deletes all imported and native projects, project members, prize links, and Devpost import records.
resetJudgingDataDeletesQueueAndJudging: Deletes all queue entries, movement history, reviews, judging sessions, winners, judge assignments, and queue notifications.
resetJudgingDataClearsChallengeMappings: Clears project-to-challenge import mappings and rebuilds one empty queue per existing challenge.
resetJudgingDataPreservesEventSetup: Keeps user accounts, applications, event settings, challenge definitions, rooms, and the audit trail.
resetJudgingDataLastWarning: Continue only if the entire event must start the project and judging flow again.
resetJudgingDataSecondConfirmDescription: Type the phrase exactly and acknowledge the permanent deletion. This opens one last confirmation.
resetJudgingDataAcknowledge: I understand this permanently deletes the event-wide project, queue, and judging data listed above.
resetJudgingDataValidation: Type the phrase exactly and acknowledge the permanent deletion.
resetJudgingDataFinalDescription: This is the last confirmation. The next action deletes the listed data for everyone and cannot be undone.
resetJudgingDataFinalWarning: Stop and cancel if you are not intentionally restarting the event's project and judging flow.
judgingDataReset: All Q data was reset. You can import projects again.
couldNotResetJudgingData: Q data could not be reset. Check the connection and try again.
deleteMyAccountDesc: Your account has no operational history (application, accreditation…), so you can delete it yourself. This will also delete any application you submitted.
areYouSureCantBeUndone: Are you sure? This action can't be undone.
accountAnonymizeDescription: This permanently removes your identity from HackUDC. Anonymous attendance and demographic information required for event auditing may remain, but will no longer be linked to you.
accountAnonymizeApplicationNote: Details about retained data are in the Privacy Policy.
accountRetainedFieldsIntro: Anonymous audit data may remain without your identity.
accountAnonymizeProofLoss: This is irreversible. HackUDC cannot later issue identity-linked participation or ECTS documentation for this account.
accountAnonymizeNoIdentityMapping: Your anonymous audit record will not be linked back to your identity.
accountAnonymizeActiveEvent: If you are attending HackUDC, this ends your participation.
accountAnonymizeExitRequired: If you are inside the venue, your request will wait for staff to record your exit.
accountAnonymizePendingExit: Your request was accepted. Sign in again to check its status or cancel it. Ask event staff to record your exit before the recovery window expires.
accountRemovalPendingExit: Your request was accepted. Sign in again to check its progress.
accountRemovalExitRequired: You must leave the venue. Staff must record your exit before account closure can finish.
accountRemovalIntegrityWarning: Operational records exist without canonical accreditation. The account can be removed, but staff should reconcile those records.
accountAnonymizeAction: Anonymize my data and close account
accountAnonymizeConfirmBody: This is irreversible. Your identity will be removed from HackUDC. Anonymous attendance and demographic information required for auditing may remain without a link to you. If you are attending, this ends your participation; named participation or ECTS documentation will no longer be possible. Learn more in the Privacy Policy.
accountRemovalPinPrompt: A security code will be sent to your verified email before this action continues.
accountRemovalPinDescription: We sent a security code to your verified email. Enter it to continue.
accountRemovalPinStaticDescription: This is a test account. Enter the configured reviewer code to continue.
accountRemovalPasswordDescription: Enter your current password to continue.
accountRemovalPinExpired: That security code expired. Request a new one to continue.
accountRemovalPinSent: We sent a security code to your verified email.
accountRemovalPinStaticSent: Use the configured reviewer code for this test account.
reviewFixturesDescription: Create a fresh set of synthetic accounts for consistent App Store review and QA.
reviewFixturesWhatChangesDescription: Replaces the synthetic participant and staff accounts used for review. Existing fixture sessions are revoked; real participant accounts and statistics are not changed.
reviewFixturesConfirmDescription: This permanently removes the previous synthetic accounts and creates fresh credentials. It does not affect real participants.
reviewFixturesRegenerateFailed: Review accounts could not be regenerated.
reviewFixturesCredentialsHint: Use the password and reviewer PIN from the isolated review notes.
reviewFixturesUsageDescription: Shows the last successful sign-in for each current synthetic account. No password, PIN or participant data is shown.
accountRemovalPending: Your request was accepted. Sign in again to check its progress.
accountRemovalPendingDescription: Your request is accepted. Ask event staff to record your exit before the recovery window ends.
accountRemovalPendingBody: Your participation has ended. Your identity will be anonymized after staff record your exit or the recovery window expires.
accountRemovalProcessingBody: Your account is being anonymized. You can no longer use HackUDC services.
accountRemovalExpiryHint: You can cancel before your exit is recorded or this timer expires.
accountRemovalRefreshError: We couldn't refresh your account-removal status. Check your connection and try again.
accountRemovalCancelBody: You can cancel while your exit has not been recorded and the recovery window is open. Your HackUDC access will be restored.
accountRemovalCancelError: The request couldn't be cancelled. Refresh and try again.
accountRemovalDeviceCleanupPending: Your account is closed, but some browser data could not be cleared. Clear this site's data before sharing the browser.
cookieNoticeBody: hackOS keeps a first-party session cookie and a few local settings so your theme, layout, and session preferences do not reset every time you blink. Groundbreaking, we know.
cookieNoticeJoke:
No ad trackers. No selling your traffic. No trading your information like office supplies.
Ursula von der Leyen may breathe easier now.
addSharedQueueDescription: Choose unassigned challenges to combine into a new shared judging queue, then review its form before saving.
sharedQueueChallengeDescription: Only challenges that are not already in a shared queue can be added here. Choose at least two.
sharedQueueReviewDescription: Edit the form used for every team in the shared queue. Create shared queue saves the selected challenges, name, and form.
splitSharedQueueDesc: Every challenge gets its own queue and judging form back. The merged form is discarded.
queuesLockedOnceJudgingStarts: Queues can no longer be merged or split: judging has started.
queueTeamSentToEnd: Team sent to the end of the queue.
couldNotSaveQueueRooms: Could not update the queue rooms.
queueCriteriaLocked: The form is locked after the first evaluation.
couldNotSaveQueueCriteria: Could not save the judging form.
roleNotFoundDesc: This role doesn't exist or was deleted.
deletingRoleRemovesDesc: Deleting this role removes it from every member who holds it.
permanentlyRemovesRoleDesc: Removes the role from every member immediately. It moves to the trash, where it can be restored.
cannotBeUndoneMembersLoseRole: This cannot be undone. Members lose the capabilities this role granted them.
superadminLockedDesc: Managed only via server CLI scripts.
resetToDefaultDescription: Replaces this role's capabilities with the ones it was seeded with. Changes below will be applied.
roleDriftedFromDefault: This role no longer matches its seeded default.
couldNotMoveRole: Couldn't reorder role. Move a neighboring role to make room, then try again.
selectRoleHint: Select a role to view its details.
capabilityDescriptionInvitesManage: Manage invite links and pre-assigned roles
capabilityDescriptionApplicationsManage: Define application forms and open/close applications
capabilityDescriptionApplicationsDecide: Accept or reject applications and send decisions
capabilityDescriptionApplicationsConfirm: Override a participant's confirm/decline as an admin
capabilityDescriptionAccreditScan: Check participants in and assign or rotate badges
capabilityDescriptionLogisticsStats: View attendance and logistics statistics panels
capabilityDescriptionQueueOperate: Call, skip, mark no-show, pause, or requeue teams
capabilityDescriptionQueueAdmin: Manage rooms, assignments, settings, and disqualifications
capabilityDescriptionJudgePanel: Bring in, start, and evaluate judging sessions
capabilityDescriptionSponsorsManage: Manage enterprises, tiers, and sponsor invites
capabilityDescriptionChallengesManage: Create, edit, and publish sponsor challenges
capabilityDescriptionTvControl: Control what displays on TV screens
capabilityDescriptionEventManage: Edit event identity and timing windows
capabilityDescriptionVenueManage: Edit venue location and Wi-Fi credentials
capabilityDescriptionWalletManage: Edit Apple Wallet pass fields and labels
allGrantRulesSearchPlaceholder: Search by trigger, role, or enterprise
triggerEventJudgeEnterpriseAssigned: Judge assigned to an enterprise's rooms
triggerEventJudgeEnterpriseRemoved: Judge removed from an enterprise's rooms
